description: Source suggestions found during the corpus-wide NE-10 audit. These routes are deliberately not projected as confirmed relationships; advancing one requires the missing exact-scope CKL claim/evidence and its record-attached sources described below.

candidates.observation: The note groups these heavenly-being texts while cautioning that a reconstructed divine-council system is not the only possible reading.
candidates.held_because: A shared CKL parent and a methodological caution do not establish a specific literary or thematic relation between every pair.
candidates.evidence_needed: A passage-specific claim comparing the particular endpoints, with its argument and sources attached.

candidates.observation: Isaiah 40-55 and Isaiah 43:14-21 use new-homecoming and exodus imagery.
candidates.held_because: The scoped claim identifies Isaiah passages but no exact Exodus passage; shared exodus vocabulary cannot supply the missing endpoint.
candidates.evidence_needed: An exact Exodus passage scope and claim-level evidence that connects it with Isaiah 43.

candidates.observation: Book-level reception metadata says Revelation recomposes Ezekiel 40-48 imagery and distinguishes its city without a temple.
candidates.held_because: The statement is a top-level reception field, not a scoped claim/evidence record with attached bibliography; it is therefore not promoted to the B bridge collection.
candidates.evidence_needed: An independently citable claim or interpretive note scoped to both passages with sources attached to that record.

candidates.observation: Book-level metadata says John 3 and 7 are often read with Ezekiel water-and-Spirit traditions and explicitly notes debate about exact allusions.
candidates.held_because: The metadata does not identify Ezekiel 37 as the precise source passage or attach a claim-level source set to that pair.
candidates.evidence_needed: An exact Ezekiel scope and source-backed argument for each proposed John passage.

observed_ckl_locations.text: 1 Corinthians 5:7 uses Passover imagery for Christ.

candidates.observation: Exodus metadata says 1 Corinthians 5:7 uses Passover imagery; the Passover event entry lists 1 Corinthians 5:7-8 as typology.
candidates.held_because: The linkage is present in parent-level connection/anchor fields, without one exact CKL claim/evidence record and record-attached sources for both passage scopes.
candidates.evidence_needed: An exact scoped claim or interpretive note comparing Exodus 12 with 1 Corinthians 5:7-8 and its own attached sources.

candidates.observation: Book-level metadata says Acts applies Psalms 2, 16, 69, 109, 110, and 118 to Jesus and enthronement.
candidates.held_because: The list does not specify the Psalm 110 / Acts 2:34-36 pair or attach evidence to that specific claim.
candidates.evidence_needed: An exact Psalm 110 and Acts 2 passage claim with source-attached discussion of the quotation and its use.

candidates.observation: Revelation metadata links its tree of life and river imagery with Genesis, Ezekiel, and Zechariah; Revelation cross-references Genesis 2-3 at book level.
candidates.held_because: The note does not name the exact Genesis passage or attach a claim-level comparison to both endpoints; broad Eden language alone is not a bridge.
candidates.evidence_needed: A claim-level comparison scoped to a specific Genesis garden/tree passage and Revelation 21-22 with its exact sources.
